QuestInfo.name: Jewel in the Thieves' Hideout
QuestInfo.0: Olive want you to talk to her. She's in front of the Jazz Bar in Kerning City.
QuestInfo.1: Olive wants information on the jewel the Thieves' Guild recently acquired. She wants you to talk to the Dark Lord. \r\nGo see the Dark Lord.
QuestInfo.2: Olive wants information on the jewel the Thieves' Guild recently acquired. She wants you to talk to the Dark Lord. \r\nGo see the Dark Lord.
QuestInfo.demandSummary: Speak with Dark Lord, the Thief Job Instructor

0.0: Here's the deal: I'm a sucker for anythin' shiny, and I hear Maple World's just brimmin' with jewels, including one recently discovered in Nihal Desert.
0.1: The Thieves Guild says the jewel rightfully belongs to them and won't tell me a thing, no matter how prettily I bat my eyelashes. Your turn to give it a shot. Maybe the #bDark Lord#k will warm up to you.

yes.0: Sweet! The Dark Lord should be here in Kerning City.

no.0: Don't get the wrong idea, here. I'm not planning to STEAL the jewel. I just want to know where it is, is all.

yes.0: You are not the first to ask about the jewel found in Nihal Desert...

npc.0: Find out more about that shiny new jewel from the #bDark Lord#k. I'd do it myself if I were a Thief, but I'm not.
